summary: First test run for EverGro eMart. Backend: 34/36 pytest tests pass (94%). Frontend: landing, admin login (password+OTP), admin dashboard with 8 KPI cards & 2 Recharts, register form, /products (10 cards), /hampers (4 tiers) all load with data-testids. Two CRITICAL backend bugs found that block the MLM commission-engine end-to-end review step from being verifiable.

critical.issue: Returns 500 'ObjectId is not iterable'. Cause: motor's insert_one mutates payload dict by injecting _id (ObjectId); handler then returns that dict, which FastAPI cannot JSON-serialize. Fix: `p.pop('_id', None)` before return OR build response from fields explicitly. Same pattern likely also in /admin/banners create (not tested).

Super Admin is seeded with current_stage=8 and wallet_balance=0. Spec/review step 'After 3rd joining-order verification, super_admin.current_stage should advance past 1 and wallet_balance should increase by ₹500 (Stage 1 commission)' is therefore impossible with a fresh DB. Admin should be seeded at current_stage=1 (or seed should be idempotently reset to 1 on each startup).

New user's `joined_at_stage` is hardcoded to 1 (the new user's own stage). But process_stage_progression queries `joined_at_stage == sponsor.current_stage`. Result: sponsor stage progression only works while sponsor is at stage 1; once advanced to stage 2+, no new referrals are counted toward that stage. Fix: set joined_at_stage = sponsor['current_stage'] (sponsor's stage at time of join).

minor.issue: Return paginated `{items, total}` shape (correct), but the frontend pages should be verified to read `data.items` (not `data` directly). Not tested in UI.
`sponsor_id` field stores sponsor's user_code (e.g., EG000001), not the referral_code. Naming is misleading; consider `sponsor_user_code` and a separate `sponsor_referral_code`.

design_issues.screen: Admin Dashboard / Users by Stage chart
issues: Bar chart shows tooltip 'users: 0' overlay even when bars have values; minor — verify chart data binding

action_items: FIX backend: POST /api/admin/products — exclude `_id` before returning (motor insert_one mutates dict). Same pattern check on POST /api/admin/banners.
FIX seed.py: super_admin should be seeded with current_stage=1 (NOT 8). Otherwise the MLM e2e review step ('admin advances past stage 1 and earns ₹500') is impossible to verify on a fresh DB.

FIX mlm_engine logic: in /auth/register, set `joined_at_stage = sponsor.current_stage` (sponsor's stage at registration time). Currently hardcoded to 1, making stage progression beyond Stage 1 impossible.
Verify frontend admin Users/Orders pages handle paginated `{items,total}` response shape (not raw list).
OPTIONAL: rename `sponsor_id` field — it actually stores sponsor's user_code, not an id.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1155 lines — should be split into routers (auth, orders, admin, mlm, site, cloudinary).
Motor insert_one mutates the payload dict by adding ObjectId _id. Multiple handlers return this dict directly. Must standardize: either project _id out or use exclude_id helper before serialization.
Admin endpoints inconsistently return list vs paginated dict — standardize to `{items, total}` everywhere or vice versa.
PaymentVerify endpoint auto-succeeds without any signature verification (MOCK mode) — correctly documented but ensure prod toggle exists before launch.
joined_at_stage semantics inconsistent with how process_stage_progression uses it — see Action Items.
process_new_referral notifies sponsor before completing referral count update; minor — no real race condition with single-server.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (landing, login pw+OTP, admin dashboard, products, hampers, register all OK)

test_credentials: Loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Used admin@evergroemart.com/Admin@123 and subadmin@evergroemart.com/SubAdmin@123. Seeded data created multiple TEST_ users via referral ADMIN001.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ users created via /auth/register with referral_code=ADMIN001 (kept in DB for downstream tests). One TEST product created and soft-deleted via admin endpoints (when create works).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py after main agent fixes (1) admin products create 500, (2) seed admin current_stage=1, (3) joined_at_stage=sponsor.current_stage. The mlm_commission_e2e test will only pass when admin starts at stage 1 — if seed isn't reset between test runs, manually reset admin via DB or recreate via wipe. Also extend frontend tests for: /dashboard, /network, /referral (QR), /wallet, /withdrawals, /kyc, /cart, /checkout, admin orders/withdrawals/kyc/users pages — these were not exercised in this run.

rca_of_the_issues.admin_products_500: motor.collection.insert_one(doc) injects ObjectId into the same dict. Handler returns this dict. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder tries to iterate ObjectId → TypeError. Fix: pop _id before return, or return public_product(p) projection.
rca_of_the_issues.mlm_e2e_blocked: Two compounding bugs: (a) seed forces admin to stage 8 on first creation, so any 'first e2e' against a fresh DB starts past stage 1; (b) joined_at_stage is the NEW user's own stage (always 1) but progression query uses sponsor.current_stage — so progression for any sponsor at stage>1 is impossible. Both must be fixed for the spec's MLM e2e to be demonstrable.
